These are compact subsets of two combined American Airlines Group / American
Airlines, Inc. filing packages: Q2 2026 accession 0000006201-26-000052 and FY2025
accession 0000006201-26-000014. They exercise legal-entity selection within the
selected face role; they are not complete filing substitutes.

Each manifest pins the original SEC document URLs, lengths and SHA256 hashes,
and records retained original fact/context IDs, units, numeric lexemes,
decimals, nil representations and source byte spans. XML fragments and root
namespace bindings were preserved; container whitespace may differ. Retained
financial dimensions are LegalEntity, ProductOrService and equity components.
The selected periods and all fourteen retained face/parenthetical roles per
filing are listed in the manifests.

`expected-anchors.json` records original XML fields and independently captured
filed HTML row/cell text. The primary HTML's URL and hash are in its manifest;
neither tests nor expectations depend on private preparation paths or a live
SEC fetch. Q2 has 42 financial anchors plus two rounded prose precision
witnesses; annual has 41 financial anchors. Source nil is distinct from zero.

Deferred revenue 13,904M is derived from the filed 9,551M and 4,353M product
components. Annual related-party cash flow has a raw +1,701M fact and a filed
(1,701) cell. Those witnesses do not establish a new synthesis or sign policy.
